plan.summary: Fix missing reasoning_effort on InferenceRequest in benchwork-core
plan.design_markdown:
# GB-94: Fix missing reasoning_effort on InferenceRequest in benchwork-core

## Context & Root Cause
In `sawhorse-core`, `InferenceRequest` gained a new field:
`pub reasoning_effort: Option<ReasoningEffort>`.
In `benchwork-core` (`crates/benchwork-core/src/hub_service.rs:164`), a raw struct literal was used without `reasoning_effort`.

## Implementation Steps
1. In `benchwork/crates/benchwork-core/src/hub_service.rs`:
   - Supply `reasoning_effort: None` in `InferenceRequest` initialization.
2. Verify:
   - Check LOC limits (<=250 LOC).
   - Run `cargo check -p benchwork-core` and `cargo test -p benchwork-core`.
   - Run Tier 2 checks: `cargo fmt --check -p benchwork-core`, `cargo clippy -p benchwork-core --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p benchwork-core`.
3. Commit atomically: `fix(benchwork-core): initialize reasoning_effort in InferenceRequest callsites`.

verification_receipt.summary: Added reasoning_effort: None in hub_service.rs, and verified all 19 tests pass
